context: A boss and his manager debate the morning political headlines
purpose: Teach: 在日/論争/分科/融合/肯定/決定的/奪わ/有限

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今朝の新聞見たか？在日企業の税制を巡る論争がまた一面だ。
lines.en: Did you see this morning's paper? The debate over taxation of foreign-affiliated companies is on the front page again.
lines.style: Gruff boss voice, gravelly authority, slight irritation as he taps the newspaper firmly with his finger.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、読みました。野党の分科会でかなり激しいやり取りがあったようですね。
lines.en: Yes, I read it. There was apparently quite a heated exchange in the opposition's subcommittee meeting.
lines.style: Measured manager tone, polite professional register, careful pacing as he chooses his words diplomatically.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 問題は政策と経済の融合がまったく見えてこないことだ。理念だけじゃ国は動かん。
lines.en: The problem is there's no visible fusion between policy and the economy. The country can't run on ideals alone.
lines.style: Dismissive grumble, lowered pitch, the cadence of a man who has said this many times before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ただ、首相の答弁を全面的に肯定する評論家も少なくないですよ。
lines.en: Still, there are quite a few commentators who fully endorse the Prime Minister's response.
lines.style: Cautious pushback, gently rising intonation, soft hedging tone to avoid open confrontation with the boss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 肯定派ね。だが今回の世論調査は決定的な打撃だぞ。支持率がガタ落ちだ。
lines.en: Supporters, huh. But this latest poll is a decisive blow — approval ratings have collapsed.
lines.style: Sharp, punctuated delivery, leaning forward with conviction, slapping the desk lightly for emphasis.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 確かに、有権者の信頼を一気に奪われた印象は否めません。
lines.en: Indeed, there's no denying the impression that voter trust was stripped away all at once.
lines.style: Reluctant agreement, slow nod implied in the voice, dropping volume on the difficult admission.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 政治家の時間は有限だ。失った信用は二度と戻らんよ。
lines.en: A politician's time is finite. Lost credibility never comes back.
lines.style: Philosophical sigh, deep exhale before speaking, world-weary baritone delivering a hard-earned truth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 肝に銘じます。我々の業界にも通じる話ですね、社長。
lines.en: I'll bear that in mind. It's a lesson that applies to our industry too, sir.
lines.style: Respectful closing tone, slight bow audible in the voice, ending with a deferential softening on 社長.
